page.layout: One page of index text, a single column at left of scan, running from the head "INDEX" at top to the last entry at bottom; the right edge is cut off. No margin notes, no running head, no page number visible.; One page of index in two columns of entries, with a running head "INDEX" (letters E X.) at the top; catchword "Regna" at the foot right.
page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so the entries "loquium bellicum", "Plectrudis" and the last line "20" are cut short at the edge. Some readings are doubtful: "Placidina" may be "Placidia"; "danata" may be "damnata"; "scitscedis" is uncertain; "PleCtrudis" is read with a long-s-like form, given as printed. The head "INDEX" is cut at its right end ("IND" visible), and the printed line is shown as "INDEX" only in reading. The first entry "Rabularium regnum" and the printed numbers are copied as they appear; some numerals in the scan are doubtful (e.g. "81, 92" may be "81, 92"). Heavy damage in the lower-left part of the column is not transcribed beyond what is legible.
